map.Emacs 编辑器命令速查：C-x/M-x 前缀、移动、编辑、搜索、窗口、缓冲区: Emacs command cheat sheet: C-x / M-x prefixes, movement, editing, search, windows and buffers.
map.Emacs 常用快捷键速查。: A quick reference for common Emacs key bindings.
map.：C-f/C-b 前后字符，C-n/C-p 上下行，C-a/C-e 行首/行尾，: : C-f / C-b move by character, C-n / C-p by line, C-a / C-e to the start / end of the line, and M-< / M-> to the start / end of the buffer.
map.：C-k 删至行尾，C-y 粘贴（yank），C-/ 撤销，C-s 增量搜索，M: : C-k kills to the end of the line, C-y yanks, C-/ undoes, C-s searches incrementally, and M-% runs query-replace.
map.：C-x C-f 打开，C-x C-s 保存，C-x b 切换缓冲区，C-x 2: : C-x C-f opens a file, C-x C-s saves it, C-x b switches buffers, and C-x 2/3 splits the window.

map.记忆 C-x C-s 等组合键。: Memorise chords such as C-x C-s.
map.刚从 Vim 或 VS Code 转过来时对照查键位，把打开文件、保存、搜索等高: Coming from Vim or VS Code, look up the key bindings side by side and memorise the high-frequency actions first: open, save, search.
map.C- 与 M- 含义？: What do C- and M- mean?
map.组合键记不住怎么办？: What if I cannot remember the chords?
map.不必一次记全，先掌握十来个高频键，其余用到再查。可开启 which-key 之类: There is no need to learn them all at once: master a dozen high-frequency bindings first and look up the rest as you need them. A hint package such as which-key shows the possible continuations in real time, or you can switch to evil / spacemacs to keep your Vim habits while you transition gradually. Muscle memory takes time, and using the editor beats memorising the whole table.

map.emacs file.txt\nemacs -nw file.txt -- 终:
emacs file.txt
emacs -nw file.txt  -- terminal mode
emacsclient -t file.txt  -- connect to the daemon
map.C-x 表示同时按 Ctrl 和 x: C-x means holding Ctrl and pressing x
map.M-x 指令名 -- 执行指令\nM-x compile -- 编译\nM-:
M-x command  -- run a command
M-x compile  -- compile
M-x shell  -- open a shell
map.C-x C-s -- 保存当前文件: C-x C-s  -- save the current file
map.C-x s -- 询问保存每个缓冲: C-x s  -- ask about saving each buffer
map.C-n 下一行\nC-p 上一行:
C-n  next line
C-p  previous line
map.C-a 行首\nC-e 行末:
C-a  line start
C-e  line end
map.M-f 下个单词\nM-b 上个单词:
M-f  next word
M-b  previous word
map.M-a 句首\nM-e 句末:
M-a  sentence start
M-e  sentence end
map.M-< 文件首\nM-> 文件末:
M-<  start of file
M->  end of file
map.C-v 下一页\nM-v 上一页:
C-v  next page
M-v  previous page
map.C-l 光标行居中\nC-u 0 C-l 行到顶部\nC-u - C-l:
C-l  center the cursor line
C-u 0 C-l  line to the top
C-u - C-l  line to the bottom
map.C-x u -- 撤销\nC-/ -- 撤销\nC-g C-/ -- 重做:
C-x u  -- undo
C-/  -- undo
C-g C-/  -- redo
map.C-SPC -- 设标记\n移动光标选区\nM-w -- 复制选区\nC-w:
C-SPC  -- set the mark
move the cursor to select
M-w  -- copy the region
C-w  -- cut the region
map.C-w 剪切选区\nM-w 复制选区\nC-y 粘贴:
C-w  cut the region
M-w  copy the region
C-y  paste
map.M-y 选择历史: M-y cycle through the kill history
map.C-y -- 粘贴\nM-y -- 替换为更早的剪贴内容:
C-y  -- paste
M-y  -- replace with an earlier kill
map.删到行末: Delete to the end of the line
map.C-k -- 删除光标到行末\n连续按删除多行:
C-k  -- delete from the cursor to the end of the line
press repeatedly to delete several lines
map.M-d 删下个单词\nM-Backspace 删上个单词:
M-d  delete the next word
M-Backspace  delete the previous word
map.C-s word 向下搜\nC-r word 向上搜\n多次 C-s 下一个:
C-s word  search forward
C-r word  search backward
press C-s again for the next match
map.M-% foo RET bar\ny 替换\nn 跳过\n! 全部替换:
M-% foo RET bar
y replace
n skip
! replace all
map.C-x b -- 切换缓冲\nC-x b *scratch* -- 切到 s:
C-x b  -- switch buffer
C-x b *scratch*  -- switch to scratch
map.C-x C-b -- 打开缓冲列表: C-x C-b  -- open the buffer list
map.C-x k -- 关闭当前缓冲: C-x k  -- kill the current buffer
map.C-x 0 关闭当前窗口\nC-x 1 只保留当前\nC-x 2 水平分割:
C-x 0  close the current window
C-x 1  keep only the current one
C-x 2  split horizontally
C-x 3  split vertically
map.C-x 5 2 新 frame\nC-x 5 0 关闭 frame:
C-x 5 2  new frame
C-x 5 0  close the frame
map.M-x shell -- 打开 shell 缓冲: M-x shell  -- open a shell buffer
map.M-x compile -- 输入 make 命令: M-x compile  -- type the make command
map.M-x grep -- 输入 grep 命令: M-x grep  -- type a grep command
map.M-x magit-status -- 打开 Git 界面: M-x magit-status  -- open the Git interface
map.C-h k C-s -- 查看 C-s 的绑定: C-h k C-s  -- show the binding of C-s
map.M-x customize -- 打开配置界面: M-x customize  -- open the configuration UI
